en.title: ABB Launches GoFa Pro: Next-Gen Collaborative Robots with AI-Powered Safety
en.summary: ABB's new GoFa Pro cobot series features embedded AI safety systems that dynamically adjust speed and force based on real-time human proximity, eliminating the need for safety fences.

zh.title: ABB 发布 GoFa Pro：搭载 AI 动力安全系统的下一代协作机器人
zh.summary: ABB 新型 GoFa Pro 协作机器人系列配备嵌入式 AI 安全系统，可根据实时人体接近距离动态调整速度和力矩，无需安全围栏。
